interpretation: Independent from-scratch scoring of all 75 CC0 fixture pairs under three published representations of Hansen solubility space. Full Hansen RED reproduces the shipped 67/75 headline exactly and gives pooled AUROC 0.9488. The Teas (1968) fractional representation -- which discards total cohesive-energy magnitude and the interaction radius R -- gives AUROC 0.8081; the Bagley (1971) volume-dependent (dV,dH) representation -- which merges the dispersion and polar axes and drops Hansen's factor-of-4 weighting -- gives AUROC 0.9221. Paired pinned-seed bootstrap (n=5000, seed=20260729): the Hansen-minus-Teas AUROC gap 95% CI is [0.044094, 0.24749] (strictly positive (Hansen better)); the Hansen-minus-Bagley gap 95% CI is [-0.047625, 0.109017] (straddles zero (noninferior)). These are threshold-free rankings so no cutoff was tuned. Applicability domain: every non-physical probe (NaN / +Inf / negative HSP / non-numeric / undefined Teas simplex) fails closed. This is a self-authored CC0 fixture, NOT external validation; the externally-validated science remains the separate BigSolDB leave-solute-out benchmark.
